Original Run, Plan definition and running node attempt checked atomically at SDK admission and capacity-delayed actual native/resource/MCP claims

limitations: Admitted SDK attempts are not physical Provider consumption or tool charges.

Existing actor/project/tool grants are checked, but complete Tool-definition/grant version is not bound atomically with the claim.
No complete MCP call-ID resume idempotency, durable planning leases, whole restart replay or persistent input/source invalidation.
No browser/frontend, full-backend, real Provider or enterprise connector acceptance this slice; public HTTP schema and frontend unchanged.
Stages 3-5 remain unfinished; Stage 6 remains conditional on actual capacity triggers.
